stories.title: Meta Targets Mass Market Automation With New Muse AI Agent
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) is making a new AI assistant called Muse to help regular people with everyday tasks like a helpful assistant.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's services, you might soon have an AI helper available, similar to having a personal secretary — but this is still early, so nothing to act on yet.

stories.title: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI solved a very difficult math problem that mathematicians have been trying to crack for 90 years, doing it in just 88 hours.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and AI researchers — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: US accuses Chinese AI firms of ‘malicious’ copying of AI technology
stories.simple_summary: The US government says Chinese AI companies copied AI technology unfairly instead of building their own.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a government trade dispute — it doesn't affect ordinary people or small business owners right now.

stories.title: Meta launches personal AI agent, Muse, to help with everyday tasks
stories.simple_summary: Meta is creating a personal AI agent called Muse to help you with everyday tasks, like scheduling or finding information.
stories.why_it_matters: In the future you might use this as a helpful digital assistant, but it's not available to most people yet.

stories.title: OpenAI Says It Has Cracked One of Math’s ‘Millennium Problems’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's artificial intelligence solved one of the world's hardest unsolved math problems that had a $1 million bounty on it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly impressive for mathematicians and AI research — it doesn't change things for everyday people or small businesses.

stories.title: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
stories.simple_summary: Meta is focusing on a new AI called Muse to try to keep up with rivals like OpenAI in the race to build better AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows competition is pushing AI companies to improve, which could mean better tools for you eventually — but nothing immediate to do.

stories.title: OpenAI fought dirty on career-making math problem, says NYU mathematician
stories.simple_summary: A mathematician at NYU says OpenAI may have played rough or unfairly in solving that hard math problem worth $1 million.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a dispute between AI companies and academics — it doesn't affect you unless you work in mathematics or AI research.

stories.title: AI power users claim Anthropic duped them with subscriptions, and they’re taking it to court
stories.simple_summary: Some paying customers are suing a company called Anthropic, saying they were misled about what they'd get from an expensive subscription plan.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a customer dispute over subscription value — as a business owner, remember to be clear about what customers actually get for their money.

stories.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
stories.simple_summary: Google Cloud is partnering with a large business company called Accenture to help sell and use AI tools for big businesses.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large companies — small business owners may see AI tools eventually, but this deal is aimed at enterprise customers.

stories.title: Chrome is now shipping updates every 2 weeks as AI changes the security landscape
stories.simple_summary: Google is releasing updates to its Chrome web browser every 2 weeks instead of less frequently, to fix security problems faster because AI is changing how threats work.
stories.why_it_matters: Your Chrome browser will update more often — you don't need to do anything; it happens automatically and keeps you safer from hackers.

stories.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
stories.simple_summary: A French AI company called Mistral raised $3 billion in funding to build AI that European countries can control themselves.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large tech companies — for ordinary people and small businesses, it's just a sign that AI companies keep growing.
